c.v: The Data Overrun Interrupt (DOI) is triggered whenever the Receive FIFO has overrun.
The DOI indicates that the Receive FIFO is full and should be cleared immediately to prevent any further overrun messages.
The DOI is only triggered by the first message that causes the Receive FIFO to overrun (i.e., the transition from the Receive FIFO not being full to the Receive FIFO overrunning).
Any subsequent overrun messages will not trigger the DOI again.
The DOI could be triggered again when all received messages (valid or overrun) have been cleared.
